item.title: contact us
item.description: The workshop is currently co-led by Vili Virkki (vilivirkki@uef.fi) and Xander Huggins (xander.huggins@ubc.ca) – please reach out to us for any queries relating to workshop activities, interest in joining future workshops, or anything else!
